def gcd(a, b):
    if a == 0 or b == 0:
        return a + b
    if a > b:
        return gcd(a % b, b)
    return gcd(b, b % a)

def solve():
    n = int(input())
    a = list(map(int, input().split()))
    T = int(input())
    
    a.sort()
    ans = 0
    for i in range(n):
        p = i + 1
        while p < n and abs(a[i] - a[p]) <= T:
            p += 1
        ans = max(ans, p - i)
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
</translated_code>
